entities.summary: Gaspar of Braganza, Archbishop-Primate of Braga was a Portuguese clergyman, and the illegitimate son of John V of Portugal and Madalena Máxima de Miranda. Known as one of the three Children of Palhavã, he later became Archbishop of Braga.
